distinguishing: Shows the seated person on the left facing right with a left-pointing horizontal arrow aimed at the torso (windshield defrost + upper-body/dash vent airflow), making it a horizontal mirror of the other torso-airflow icon and interchangeable with it in meaning, while differing from the two icons with a downward arrow toward the feet.
